The callTool function returns an object that gets serialized as JSON, but the protocol catches errors and wraps them. Let me look at how errors propagate:

```javascript
try {
    ...
    result=await callTool(req.params.name,req.params.arguments||{});
    process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({jsonrpc:'2.0',id:req.id,result})+'\n');
} catch(error) { process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({jsonrpc:'2.0',id:req.id,error:{code:-32602,message:error.message}})+'\n'); }
```

So errors thrown by callTool are caught and serialized with code -32602 (Invalid params) and message from error.

Let me now write the server.mjs:

```javascript
import customers from './customers.json' with {type:'json'};

const TOOLS = [
  {
    name: 'customer_lookup',
    description: 'Look up a customer by their ID and return their profile.',
    inputSchema: {
      type: 'object',
      properties: {
        customer_id: {
          type: 'string',
          description: 'The unique identifier of the customer.'
        }
      },
      required: ['customer_id'],
      additionalProperties: false
    }
  }
];

export async function listTools() {
  return TOOLS;
}

export async function callTool(name, args) {
  if (name !== 'customer_lookup') {
    throw new Error(`Unknown tool: ${name}`);
  }
  if (!args || typeof args !== 'object' || Array.isArray(args)) {
    throw new Error('Invalid arguments: expected an object');
  }
  const allowed = Object.keys(TOOLS[0].inputSchema.properties);
  const provided = Object.keys(args);
  const extra = provided.filter(k => !allowed.includes(k));
  if (extra.length > 0) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid argument(s): ${extra.join(', ')}`);
  }
  const { customer_id } = args;
  if (typeof customer_id !== 'string' || customer_id.length === 0) {
    throw new Error('Invalid arguments: customer_id must be a non-empty string');
  }
  const customer = customers[customer_id];
  if (!customer) {
    throw new Error(`Unknown customer: ${customer_id}`);
  }
  const summary = `Customer ${customer_id}: ${customer.name} (${customer.tier} tier)`;
  return { content: [{ type: 'text', text: summary }] };
}
```
